ask.description: The ask id from the chief's batch message.

result.description: close: the ask is done. merge: it is the same as another open ask. send: a session should answer it. owner: the owner must decide it.

into.description: For merge: the open ask id to merge into.

to.description: For send: the session id that should answer it.

why_you.description: For owner: why only the owner can decide it.
